title: How to Find Your Company's Core Values (20-Minute Exercise)
description:
Your real core values are already in your business. This 20 minute exercise finds them.
https://allthepower.co.uk

Most company values are decoration. Three nice words on a wall that nobody in the building believes, including the owner.

This lesson shows you how to discover the values already living in how you and your best people work, turn them from labels into behaviours you can actually watch someone do, and then use them to hire, coach and, when you have to, let someone go. Including the hardest case of all: the high performer who hits every number and breaks every value.

By the end you will have three to five real values, each with a lives-it and breaks-it example, and a five question gut check to make sure they hold.

This is a Thrive Business Community exercise. Take it to your team.

6:27 Set the bar: the plus minus rating
7:18 Hiring and coaching on your values
7:55 The high performer problem
9:11 The five question gut check
9:40 The questions under the poster
